items.question: What does this local proof validate?
items.answer: It validates that Roller Rink Rentals can use the same frontend with a separate tenant, theme, pages, sitemap, and contact form workflow.

items.question: Is this final production content?
items.answer: No. It is safe local-proof content for testing the second site before full production copy, images, and marketing claims are prepared.

items.question: Does this seed include secrets?
items.answer: No. The tenant template uses a placeholder API hash and requires a local environment variable at seed time.
